## Technical details

### atom/ColorSwatch/ColorSwatch.vue

This is a single color-element only.

Some props:

* href: link, used with NuxtLink. Optional. If none is given, element is rendered as button.
* colorMode: on-dark, on-light
* isSelected: bool, highlights the element as selected
* colors: array of css-color strings (display a maximum of two colors)

I'd appreciate it, if you could implement this with just a single html element. To display multiple colors, use linear-gradient

### organism/ProductTile/ProductTileSwatches.vue

Render a list of colors. Maximum of 4.

Some props:

* swatches: array of swatch (a swatch is an array of colors to be passed to LuiColorSwatch)
* selectedIndex: number

longDescription:
## Purpose

The ColorSwatch component provides a compact visual representation of product color options, enabling customers to quickly browse available variants without leaving the product listing view.

## Use Cases

- Display single-color product variants as clickable swatches
- Show multi-color or patterned variants using linear gradients
- Indicate the currently selected color variant with an active state
- Handle overflow gracefully when products have many color options (5+)
- Support dark background contexts for varied page designs

## Design Rationale

The component is implemented as a single HTML element for optimal performance and rendering efficiency. Using CSS linear-gradients enables multi-color display without additional markup. The maximum of 4 visible swatches with overflow indicator prevents visual clutter while still communicating variant availability. Interactive states including hover tooltips improve discoverability of color names.
